articles.summary: Self-reported internships need a clear verification process. Learn how career centers can define acceptable evidence, use employer confirmation, handle incomplete or disputed records, document exceptions, and assign staff ownership.
articles.title: How Should Career Centers Verify Self-Reported Internships?

articles.summary: A guide for career services teams to help students navigate federal hiring, from USAJOBS and eligibility requirements to federal resumes, Pathways opportunities, assessments, and hiring timelines.
articles.title: How Career Centers Can Prepare Students for Federal Government Hiring

articles.title: How Career Centers Can Use Student Ambassadors for Tool Adoption

articles.title: How Career Centers Can Build Tech Adoption Beyond One Staff Champion

articles.summary: Should students earn rewards for completing career activities, demonstrating improvement, or meeting readiness standards? Explore incentive models, qualification criteria, real university examples, and ways to encourage meaningful career tool engagement beyond initial participation.
articles.title: How Career Centers Can Sustain Career Tool Engagement With Incentives
